headCss: .ds-chip[data-chip-animate]:active:not(.ds-chip--disabled){scale:.955 .925}.ds-chip--outlined:hover:not(.ds-chip--disabled),.ds-chip--filled:hover:not(.ds-chip--disabled){background-color:var(--accent)}.ds-chip--disabled.ds-chip--outlined{border-color:var(--muted);background-color:var(--muted)}.ds-chip--disabled.ds-chip--filled{background-color:var(--muted)}.ds-chip--error.ds-chip--outlined{border-color:var(--destructive);color:var(--destructive)}.ds-chip--error.ds-chip--outlined:hover:not(.ds-chip--disabled){background-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 6%, var(--background))}.ds-chip--error.ds-chip--filled{background-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 8%, var(--background));color:var(--destructive)}.ds-chip--error.ds-chip--filled:hover:not(.ds-chip--disabled){background-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 12%, var(--background))}.ds-chip--focused{box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--stroke-medium) var(--focus-ring-color);outline:none}.ds-chip:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--stroke-medium) var(--focus-ring-color);outline:none}.ds-chip__icon svg,.ds-chip__close svg{width:100%;height:100%}.ds-chip--error .ds-chip__close{background-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 10%, transparent)}.ds-chip--disabled .ds-chip__close{cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none;background-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 4%, transparent)}@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) and (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-chip[data-chip-animate]:hover:not(.ds-chip--disabled){transition:background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.19, 1, .22, 1), border-color .15s cubic-bezier(.19, 1, .22, 1), scale var(--duration-500) 50ms cubic-bezier(.32, .72, 0, 1);scale:1.06 1.095}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-chip{transition-duration:0s}.ds-chip:active:not(.ds-chip--disabled){scale:1}}@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) and (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-chip__close:hover{background-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 12%, transparent);scale:1.06 1.095}.ds-chip--error .ds-chip__close:hover{background-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 18%, transparent)}}
